title: BlockLimit
description:
A  server-side mod. that limits the amount of specific blocks per chunk.
Supports configurable limits, modded blocks, admin reports, and automatic item return when the limit is exceeded.
body:
Block-Limit

When a player tries to place a block above the configured limit, the placement is cancelled and the item is returned to the player.

Features
Limit specific blocks per chunk
Supports vanilla and modded blocks
Server-side only
Configurable limits
Optional admin reports
Returns the block item when placement is blocked
Supports online admin notifications
Configuration

The config file is located here:

world/serverconfig/blocklimiter-server.toml

Example config:

[general]
regulated_blocks = [
  "minecraft:hopper|32|true",
  "minecraft:chest|64|false",
  "create:andesite_casing|16|true"
]

admin_names = ["AdminNick1", "AdminNick2"]
ignore_creative_players = true
How to Add Blocks

Each block rule uses this format:

"block_id|max_per_chunk|send_report"

Example:

"minecraft:hopper|32|true"

This means:

minecraft:hopper — block ID
32 — maximum amount of this block allowed in one chunk
true — send a report to admins when the limit is exceeded

To add a modded block, use its registry ID:

"create:andesite_casing|16|true"
Config Options
regulated_blocks

List of blocks controlled by the mod.

Format:

"modid:block_name|limit|report"

Examples:

"minecraft:hopper|32|true"
"minecraft:chest|64|false"
"thermal:machine_furnace|8|true"
admin_names

List of admin nicknames who will receive reports.

Example:

admin_names = ["AdminNick1", "AdminNick2"]

Only online admins from this list will receive messages.

ignore_creative_players

Controls whether creative mode players are ignored.

ignore_creative_players = true

If true, creative players can bypass limits.
If false, creative players are also limited.
